captions.detailed: A tall, industrial-style steel CCTV mast consisting of a long, vertical cylindrical pole mounted on a square, dark grey steel baseplate with four corner bolts. At the top of the pole sits a dark grey panning bracket assembly that rotates horizontally. Mounted within this bracket is a light grey rectangular camera housing that tilts vertically on a horizontal axis, complete with a dark grey lens hood and mounting fixtures.
captions.instruction: Design a 3D model of a steel CCTV mast with a square base plate, a long tubular pole, a pan unit that rotates on a vertical axis, and a camera head that tilts on a horizontal axis, using realistic metallic grey and dark grey materials.
captions.factory: Construct a base plate using a thin box primitive and four small cylinders for bolts, then add the main vertical pole using a tall cylinder. Create the panning mount at the top of the pole using a cylinder for the collar and a U-shaped bracket made of combined box primitives. Build the camera head with a box for the body, a small horizontal cylinder for the lens, and attach it to the panning mount using a horizontal revolute joint to enable tilting.
